text:
sophia: hey team — quick async micro-quarter status for OKR: runtime stability & v4 rollout. please reply with one line each: shipped / slipped / owner / next step. goal: have a clear delta for Tues demo.

mike: shipped — canary traffic bumped to 10% in us-west, median p95 latency down 8% vs v3. owner: mike. next: merge rollout helper and increase to 25% after one healthy day. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1245

anya: slipped — quantization pipeline (onnx->int4) still failing on some GPUs due to cudnn driver mismatch. owner: anya. next: file infra ticket + try pinned cuda runtime on a small pool. ETA +2w unless we get a driver rollback exemption.

lin: blocking — e2e test suite has intermittent auth flake that causes canary health checks to fail (~1/200 runs). seen in nightly logs: `ERROR auth: token expired while refreshing`. owner: lin/eng-infra. next: quarantine flaky test, run extended canary w/ flaky test disabled.

kevin: cr ping — @mike I left comments on rollout script and docs missing the new config knobs. please address before full rollout. Also need a short blurb for the runbook.

deploy-bot: prod-canary: runtime-v4 -> us-west started at 3167779000, status: progressing :rocket:

mike: ack, will update PR and docs today EOD, then tag for merge. I can also add a quick healthcheck that ignores the flaky auth test as a temporary measure.

anya: filing infra ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7890 — asking infra for driver rollback window. tagging @lin for test impact. :memo:

lin: thanks — I can disable the flaky test in the canary pipeline and re-run the 24h smoke. if failures exceed 5% we roll back.

sophia: action items captured: 1) @mike update PR + docs, 2) @anya coordinate INF-7890 with eng-infra, 3) @lin mute flaky test for canary and monitor, 4) @kevin draft runbook blurb. I'll compile a short status note for the demo. Ping me if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:

kevin: noted — I'll drop the runbook snippet in the OKR doc and ping for review.

mike: update: pushed patch for healthcheck + addressed comments, PR now at 3167779255, requesting final review.

anya: update: infra acknowledged INF-7890, tentative rollback window 48h from now if needed.

lin: monitoring canary now, will post a short recap in the morning.

sophia: perfect, thanks everyone. small ask: if you actually ship something (merge/deploy), reply with `shipped: <artifact> <link>` so I can mark it in the OKR doc. otherwise `slipped: <reason>`.
